about: Catalog of public dam-safety, hazard-classification and dam-design references for fetch_asdso.py --catalog. Group 'hazard' = the sources cited in 'US Dam Hazard Classification - Corrected Edition' and 'Dam Hazard Classification Summaries' (2026-11-09). Group 'design' = dam design, hydrology and consequence references. Group 'breach' = dam-break / breach-analysis guidance and breach-parameter methods (HEC, FERC R21, FEMA P-946, state dam-break guidance, Froehlich/Wahl). Group 'software' = documentation and citable references for the modelling tools the suite runs: LISFLOOD-FP 8.0-8.3, Gmsh, ANUGA and HEC-RAS. kind: pdf (download; alt URLs tried in order), html (law/policy web page saved as Markdown text), index (download the PDF links on a page that match 'match'), manual (no stable public link found: listed in sources.csv to get by hand). check: 'tested' = downloaded from the cloud workspace; 'listed' = URL taken from a search-engine listing of the file; 'cited' = host and file named in the attached PDFs; 'pattern' = built from the publisher's usual URL pattern, not seen. Edit freely: add entries, fix URLs, or set 'skip': true.
